verdict: Leads are coming in — but ad tracking is missing most of them.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your ads tracked 7 leads at a cost per lead of $232.05, but your CRM recorded 679 opportunities and 44 jobs won in the same window — a gap that points to a tracking disconnect, not a shortfall in actual demand. Your Google Business Profile for "Quality HVAC by Fibid" received 206 impressions this period but generated zero calls, which indicates a broken or missing phone number on that listing; an audit is already underway. Google Ads spend pulled back 45% in the last 7 days, which brought the blended cost per lead down 29% — we're monitoring that closely to confirm it holds without a drop in lead volume. Coming up, heating campaign creative and content are due by September 30, with full heating campaigns on Google and Meta going live October 1.
